sub_items.description: Lawsuit preamble and Israel/Mengele references (including embedded image of Bibi Netanyahu and point 19 regarding the moon landing)
Grievance alleging Candace accused Harpole of criminal negligence regarding ambulance absence
Grievance re: "Charlie's Angels or Demons" episode alleging implication of security team complicity
Grievance re: "The Great Exodus from Utah" episode alleging failure-to-render-aid via medical bag and lying about drone availability
Point 29 – assertion that Harpole is a private citizen and not a limited-purpose public figure
Point 28 – citation of Harpole's November 17 Shawn Ryan appearance as defensive response to "Owens and other conspiracy theorists"
Point 50/59 – explanation that Harpole did not respond to Candace's texts to avoid giving her exclusive content
Points 54-55 – embedded text messages from Candace Owens to Brian Harpole
Point 63 – allegation that Candace's "Fort Huachuca confirmed" X post claimed proof that Snow was telling the truth about Harpole
Text: "Also, yes, I will say something about the security. I know them well."

First message: "Hi Brian, this is Candace Owens. A lot of people are telling me that you're planting seeds regarding a lawsuit. I wanted to see if you wanted to have an off-record discussion with me about anything or if you'd like to simply clarify something that you think that I got wrong."
Second message (Dec 19 follow-up): "Hi Brian, just again reaching out in case you want to clarify your whereabouts on the morning of September 9th. I'm only interested in the truth."
Third message: "Hey Brian, reaching out again to see if you'd be willing to speak about the morning of the 9th... I oddly cannot get you to confirm or deny if you were there."

Audio: "I know there's a lot of conspiracy theories floating in about the security guard and people thinking he was making gestures. I know that security person. He's a good guy... I don't I don't buy that one, okay? I don't buy that one."
Initial text regarding Sorensen Center rooftop access
Chief Long reply: "I got you covered."

X post text: "Find your favorite podcaster who joined the psychological operation to convince you that Mitch was lying about having been at Fort Huachuca... I always believed Mitch's story... What we cannot confirm as of yet is his memory of who he is convinced he saw coming out of that early morning meeting."

Audio: "Number one, why did you claim Candace said that Erika killed Charlie. She's never said it that I've seen... Talked to Candace, I've never heard her say that... No one who's ever been on this show has ever said that."
Audio discussing myths regarding Mengele's twin transfusions and the "sewing twins together" legend
Times of Israel headline: "US House is considering a resolution condemning Hasan [Piker] and Candace Owens for anti-Semitism"

Resolution passages: "Whereas Candace Owens has employed rhetoric that has included conspiracy theories accusing Israel of controlling the United States government... Government promoting false claims that Jews are taught by ancient religious texts to hate non-Jews... she made the anti-Semitic claim that the United States is controlled by satanic pedophiles who work for Israel... she repeated false claims that Jews are killing Christian children."

Audio: "This political violence stems from a systemic demonization of him and his supporters by commentators... deranged lies and smears against the president, his family, his supporters have led crazy people to believe crazy things."

Post: "His monologue about my family is not comedy. His words are corrosive and deepens the political sickness within America. People like Kimmel shouldn't have the opportunity to enter our homes each evening to spread hate."
Post: "Hate speech does not exist legally in America. There's ugly speech, there's gross speech, there's evil speech, and all of it is protected by the First Amendment. Keep America free."

Audio: "I spent thousands of dollars on drones last year... if the area lies in the Provo, Utah airspace, I can't fly. That's a 107B... we can't break the rules... on our way in, we had drone footage of the crowd building... I said, Charlie, I don't like this place. There are too many buildings."
Selected comments including Michael Jester's note about malicious-prosecution exposure for SLAPP suits and Jen Common's note on UVU drone authorization form
Audio clip of the host's interview with Mitch Snow, in which she says she can confirm the route and meeting with metadata but cannot confirm who he saw
Host verbal reference to Brian Harpole's flight records showing afternoon departures from Dallas (not shown)

claims.label: Harpole Filed 69-Page Defamation Lawsuit Against Candace Owens
claims.claim: Brian Harpole filed a 69-page civil complaint against Candace Owens asserting multiple defamation claims.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the filed complaint and PACER docket to verify the exact count and nature of causes of action.

claims.label: Pre-Filing Email Announced Lawsuit Would Proceed Regardless of Retraction
claims.claim: The host says Harpole's counsel sent an email styled as a retraction demand but stated at the outset that the lawsuit would be filed in four days regardless.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the pre-filing email; verify whether it contained a formal retraction request.

claims.label: Lawsuit Alleges Candace Accused Harpole of Criminal Negligence Regarding Ambulance
claims.claim: Per the pre-filing demand letter the host reads, which she says summarizes the lawsuit, Candace accused Harpole and his team of criminal negligence by failing to have an ambulance on standby and failing to render aid after Kirk was shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the quoted podcast passage against the actual transcript to verify Candace's exact words.

claims.label: Lawsuit Alleges "Charlie's Angels or Demons" Episode Implied Security Team Had Insider Knowledge
claims.claim: Per the pre-filing demand letter the host reads, Candace's episode implied Harpole's security team had foreknowledge of and complicity in Kirk's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and review the "Charlie's Angels or Demons" episode to verify whether Harpole was named and to identify the actual subjects of the commentary.

claims.label: Lawsuit Alleges Candace Falsely Accused Harpole of Failing to Render Aid via Medical Bag and Lying About Drone Availability
claims.claim: Per the pre-filing demand letter the host reads, Candace accused Harpole of failing to render effective aid with his medical bag and of lying about drone availability.
claims.investigative_direction: Review "The Great Exodus from Utah" episode transcript; compare Candace's exact statements to the lawsuit's quoted passages.

claims.label: Lawsuit Asserts Harpole Is a Private Citizen
claims.claim: Per point 29 of the lawsuit the host reads, Harpole asserts he is a private individual, not a limited-purpose public figure, despite two podcast appearances; the host disputes this.
claims.investigative_direction: Review defamation caselaw on limited-purpose public figure doctrine and assess Harpole's voluntary insertion into the controversy.

claims.label: Lawsuit Cites November 17 Shawn Ryan Appearance as Defensive Response
claims.claim: Point 28 of the lawsuit asserts Harpole appeared on Shawn Ryan "solely to respond to and to rebut the defamatory statements" by Candace and other conspiracy theorists.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the air date of Harpole's Shawn Ryan appearance and the prior existence (or absence) of Candace's commentary naming Harpole.

claims.label: Candace First Mentioned Harpole by Name on November 19, Two Days After His Shawn Ryan Appearance
claims.claim: Candace states she never once mentioned Harpole on her podcast prior to his November 17 Shawn Ryan appearance; her first mention was November 19.
claims.investigative_direction: Audit Candace's prior episode transcripts and show notes for any reference to him prior to November 19.

claims.label: Candace Says Harpole Left Her Text Messages Unanswered
claims.claim: The host says she sent Harpole about four text messages, from shortly before her Mitch Snow interview through January, offering an off-record talk or asking him to clarify his whereabouts on September 9, and that he did not reply to any of them.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the embedded text messages against phone records; verify Harpole's receipt.

claims.label: Lawsuit Claims Harpole's Non-Response Was Intended to Avoid Giving Candace Exclusive Content
claims.claim: Per point 59 of the lawsuit the host reads, her repeated texts to Harpole were a cynical attempt to profit by coddling him into giving her exclusive content; the host reads this as the lawsuit's explanation for his not replying.
claims.investigative_direction: Assess credibility of this litigation rationale against the timing (December to April delay) and the lawsuit-filing posture.

claims.label: Candace Publicly Defended Harpole and the TPUSA Security Team Against Hand-Signal Conspiracies in September
claims.claim: Candace texted Andrew Kolvet agreeing to defend the security team and issued a same-day podcast statement defending Harpole and Dan Flood.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the September 2025 episode in which Candace defended the security team.

claims.label: Host Says Lawsuit Admits the Rooftop Text Chain Was Between Dan Flood and Chief Long, Not Harpole
claims.claim: The host says that although Harpole presented the Sorensen Center rooftop text chain on Shawn Ryan as his own, the lawsuit admits the messages were between Dan Flood and UVU Police Chief Long.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the original Shawn Ryan audio against the lawsuit's admission to identify the precise point of misrepresentation.

claims.label: Candace's December 23 X Post Confirmed Fort Huachuca but Did Not Confirm Snow's Identification of Harpole
claims.claim: Candace's December 23 X post stated Fort Huachuca was confirmed via metadata and incident report but explicitly stated the team could not confirm Snow's identification of who he saw.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original X post screenshot and verify text against the quoted excerpt.

claims.label: Lawsuit Simultaneously Accuses Candace of Confirming Snow's Claim While Including Her Explicit Non-Confirmation
claims.claim: Point 63 of the lawsuit accuses Candace of asserting proof that Snow was telling the truth about Harpole, even while, the host says, the very next paragraph presents her statement that she could not confirm the identification.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific X post passages cited by the lawsuit to determine whether the allegation is supported by context.

claims.label: Host Says Harpole's Drone Statement Conflicts with Frank Turek's Account
claims.claim: The host says Harpole's statement that drones could not be flown in Provo airspace conflicts with Frank Turek's separate account of drones being flown at the UVU event.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full audio of Turek's drone statements and cross-reference with FAA Part 107 rules for Provo airspace.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Publicly Claimed Candace Accused Her of Killing Charlie
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk publicly claimed that Candace accused her of murdering Charlie Kirk, which the host calls obviously untrue; in a clip the host plays, Baron Coleman says everyone had the same reaction to it.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Erika Kirk's original statement on video or social media to verify exact wording and context.

claims.label: Candace States She Does Not Believe Erika Kirk Murdered Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: Candace asserts she has never publicly accused Erika Kirk of murdering Charlie and explicitly disclaims that belief.
claims.investigative_direction: Audit Candace's prior podcast transcripts and X posts for any statement that could be construed as accusing Erika.

claims.label: Baron Coleman Questioned Erika's Claim That Candace Had Accused Her
claims.claim: Baron Coleman stated on his show that he had never heard Candace say Erika killed Charlie and questioned why Erika made the claim.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Coleman's full segment for additional context.

claims.label: Lawler and Gottheimer Introduced Bipartisan House Resolution Condemning Candace Owens
claims.claim: The host says, citing a Times of Israel headline, that Reps. Mike Lawler and Josh Gottheimer brought forward a bipartisan House resolution condemning her, among others.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full resolution text from Congress.gov and verify resolution number, co-sponsors, and referral.

claims.label: Resolution Alleges Candace Accused Israel of Controlling the United States Government
claims.claim: The resolution text characterizes Candace's rhetoric as accusing Israel of controlling the US government.
claims.investigative_direction: Audit Candace's prior commentary for any statement matching the resolution's characterization.

claims.label: Resolution Alleges Candace Claimed Satanic Pedophiles Work for Israel
claims.claim: The resolution text asserts Candace made an anti-Semitic claim that the United States is controlled by satanic pedophiles who work for Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Candace's commentary on Epstein, Israeli intelligence, and pedophilia rings for the exact phrasing.

claims.label: Resolution References Candace's Josef Mengele Commentary
claims.claim: Per the resolution the host describes, it references her July 2024 remark about 'bizarre propaganda' following the Holocaust; the host says she did not mention Josef Mengele and that the remark is objectively true.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Candace's July 2024 statements about Mengele and verify exact wording.

claims.label: Auschwitz Memorial Podcast Acknowledged Myths About Mengele's Twin Experiments
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays from the official Auschwitz-Birkenau Memorial podcast, a speaker says that myths arose around Mengele, including the "sewing twins together" legend, which did not happen.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Auschwitz Memorial podcast episode for full context.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk's May 2, 2024 Tweet Denied the Legal Existence of Hate Speech
claims.claim: Charlie Kirk wrote on May 2, 2024 that "Hate speech does not exist legally in America."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the post's date, persistence, and any replies or context.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Wrongly Claimed the Host Accused Her of Murder
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk 'put a target on my back' by wrongly asserting that the host accused her of murdering her husband.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Erika Kirk's April 29 statement and compare its exact wording to the host's prior published statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: She essentially put a target on my back by wrongly asserting that I accused her of murdering her husband.

claims.label: Host Says Harpole Never Sent a Retraction Demand or Spoke to Her Before
claims.claim: The host says Brian Harpole never communicated with her, never issued a retraction demand and never answered her outreach before the lawsuit email arrived.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the pre-filing email and the host's lawyers' correspondence log to confirm that no earlier retraction request exists.
claims.transcript_snippet: You never communicated with me, you never spoke, you never issued any sort of retraction demand, you never answered me when I reached out.

claims.label: Host Says Harpole's Lawyer Is the Lawyer the Daily Wire Used Against Her
claims.claim: The host says Harpole is using the same lawyer the Daily Wire used to sue her in arbitration for two years, and that the lawyer is publicly tweeting and has a YouTube channel.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare counsel of record in the Harpole complaint with counsel in the Daily Wire arbitration.
claims.transcript_snippet: Brian Harpole is using the same lawyer the Daily Wire used to sue me in arbitration for 2 years straight.

claims.label: Host Says Ambulances Were Standard at Her TPUSA Events With Harpole's Team
claims.claim: The host says she is fairly certain that at almost every one of her many Turning Point USA events during the time Harpole was on the security team, an ambulance was on standby.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect event run-of-show or medical-staffing documents from prior TPUSA events and the UVU event to compare ambulance provisions.
claims.transcript_snippet: at each and every one of my many events that I have done with Turning Point USA during a time period when Brian Harpole was always a member of the security team, we had an ambulance on standby.

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Texted His Security the Night Before That He Expected to Be Killed
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk texted his security team the night before the event and said he thought he was going to be killed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the night-before text thread and its recipients; ask security leadership to confirm or deny receipt.
claims.transcript_snippet: texts you guys the night before and says, "I think I'm going to be killed."

claims.label: Host Says the Term Criminal Negligence Did Not Come From Her Podcast
claims.claim: The host says she did not accuse Harpole of criminal negligence and that the term did not come from her podcast but from the lawsuit.
claims.investigative_direction: Search the episode transcripts cited in the complaint for the phrase 'criminal negligence' or equivalent wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: Um I most certainly did not accuse you of criminal negligence. That term did not come from this podcast.

claims.label: Host Says the Charlie's Angels or Demons Episode Never Named Harpole
claims.claim: The host says that in the 'Charlie's Angels or Demons' episode she never mentioned Harpole even once, and that it concerned Charlie's chief of staff and Terryl Farnsworth, the head of the AV team.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the full episode transcript for any reference to Harpole or the security detail.
claims.transcript_snippet: In that particular episode, we never mentioned Brian Harpole or referred to him even once.

claims.label: Host Says Farnsworth Announced Kirk Dead by Selfie Video Two Minutes After the Shot
claims.claim: The host says Terryl Farnsworth notoriously announced in a selfie video that Charlie Kirk was dead about two minutes after Kirk went down, when no one could have known.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Farnsworth's selfie video with its original upload time and compare it to the shot time and first official confirmation.
claims.transcript_snippet: it was Terryl Farmsworth who notoriously announced in a selfie video that Charlie Kirk was dead like 2 minutes after Charlie went down

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy and Farnsworth Filmed Themselves Announcing the Death
claims.claim: The host reads her own earlier quotation saying Mikey McCoy and others were picking up phone calls and filming themselves prematurely announcing that Charlie was dead.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify any video in which Mikey McCoy announces the death and compare timing to first confirmation.
claims.transcript_snippet: They were already filming themselves prematurely announcing Charlie is dead, when not a single person could have known that Charlie Kirk was dead.

claims.label: Host Says Her Medical Bag Line Was Only a Description
claims.claim: The host says her full quotation about Harpole's medical bag was a description of him running to Charlie with a small bag that was supposed to be a medical bag.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the quoted line with the full 'The Great Exodus from Utah' transcript.
claims.transcript_snippet: Brian is the one who then runs over to Charlie and again you recognize him because he kind of has that uh small supposed to be medical bag over him.

claims.label: Turek Audio Says Kirk's Team Had Drones Up and Texted Crowd Video
claims.claim: In the Frank Turek clip played on air, Turek says that on the drive in Kirk's team had drones up looking at the crowd and texted video of thousands of people an hour before the start.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Turek interview audio and the drone footage or text messages he describes.
claims.transcript_snippet: we're driving in, Megan, and his team has drones up um looking at the crowd from above and they they text him some video.

claims.label: Host Says a Drone-Training Pilot Told Her Drones Can Be Flown in Provo
claims.claim: The host says a pilot who runs drone training told her that the Provo airspace restriction applies around airports and hangars, but that drones can be flown in Provo with clearance as needed.
claims.investigative_direction: Check FAA Part 107 airspace authorization records for the UVU campus and any waiver requests filed for the event.
claims.transcript_snippet: Yeah, you can't fly in Provo airspace meaning around airports. You would have to get clearance. You can't fly uh near hangars. But you can fly drones in Provo.

claims.label: Host Says the Lawsuit Opens With Strong Support for Israel and a Netanyahu Picture
claims.claim: The host says the first pages of the 69-page lawsuit express strong support for Israel and embed a picture of Benjamin Netanyahu.
claims.investigative_direction: Read the opening paragraphs and exhibits of the complaint to confirm the Israel references and the image.
claims.transcript_snippet: he begins the lawsuit and I'm talking like the first few pages with strong support for Israel.

claims.label: Host Says the Lawsuit Mentions the Moon Landing and She Believes It Was Fake
claims.claim: The host says point 19 of the lawsuit mentions that she does not believe in the moon landing, and she states she thinks the moon landing was fake.
claims.investigative_direction: Read paragraph 19 of the complaint to confirm the moon-landing reference.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't believe the moon landing. Guilty as charged. Guilty as charged. I I think the moon landing was fake.

claims.label: Host States the Limited-Purpose Public Figure Rule and Says Harpole Fits It
claims.claim: The host says private citizens can become limited-purpose public figures by voluntarily thrusting themselves into a public controversy, and that Harpole did so by appearing on the Shawn Ryan podcast.
claims.investigative_direction: Have a defamation lawyer assess Harpole's status under Tennessee or Utah limited-purpose public figure case law.
claims.transcript_snippet: private citizens can indeed become limited purpose public figures when they voluntarily thrust themselves into the forefront of a particular public controversy to influence its outcome.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Asked Her to Defend the Security Team Publicly
claims.claim: The host says that after a phone call in which she told Andrew Kolvet she did not believe the hand-signal conspiracies, Kolvet asked whether she would say something publicly because the team was getting hammered, and she agreed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's phone log and the text exchange with Kolvet from that day.
claims.transcript_snippet: And Andrew asked me if I would be willing to say something publicly on my podcast to that effect because they were getting hammered and I said, "Of course I will."

claims.label: Host Says She Defended Harpole and Flood Without Naming Them
claims.claim: The host says she went to great lengths to defend Harpole and Dan Flood without mentioning their names so the public would not find them during the early conspiracy theories.
claims.investigative_direction: Audit September 2025 episodes for any naming of Harpole or Flood.
claims.transcript_snippet: I went through great lengths to defend both Brian Harpole and Dan Flood without mentioning their names cuz I didn't want the public to find them

claims.label: Host Recounts Early Hand-Signal Theories About Turek, Flood and Harpole
claims.claim: The host says the early conspiracy theories claimed Frank Turek, Dan Flood and Brian Harpole were making hand signals behind Charlie's back, and that she did not believe them.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original posts that circulated the hand-signal theories and their dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: Frank Turek's doing hand signals. It looks like Dan Flood's doing hand signals. It looks like Brian Harpole is doing hand signals behind his back and they're all looped in.
